```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(patchwork)
library(rstatix)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

iris.df <- read.csv("/workspaces/R/test/iris.csv")
head(iris.df)
```

# Test dplyr
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
iris.df %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), list(mean = \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                                      sd = \(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))))
```

# Test rstatix
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
iris.df %>% t_test(petal_length ~ species)
```

# Test data.table
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# 1. Einen data.table aus dem bekannten iris-Dataframe erstellen
dt <- as.data.table(iris)

# 2. Zeilen filtern (analog zu filter() in dplyr): 
# Alle Blumen, bei denen Sepal.Length größer als 5.0 ist
filtered_dt <- dt[Sepal.Length > 5.0]
head(filtered_dt)

# 3. Neue Spalte hinzufügen (mit dem := Operator, der sehr effizient im Speicher arbeitet)
dt[, Sepal.Ratio := Sepal.Length / Sepal.Width]
head(dt)

# 4. Aggregieren / Gruppieren (analog zu group_by + summarise):
# Berechne den Mittelwert von Sepal.Length und Sepal.Width pro Spezies
result <- dt[, .(
  Mean_Sepal_Length = mean(Sepal.Length),
  Mean_Sepal_Width = mean(Sepal.Width)
), by = Species]

print(result)
```

# Test ggplot2
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
ggplot(iris.df, aes(x = petal_length, y = petal_width, color = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Petal Length vs Petal Width by Species",
       x = "Petal Length",
       y = "Petal Width") +
  theme_minimal()
``` 

# Test patchwork
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
p1 <- ggplot(iris.df, aes(x = petal_length, y = petal_width, color = species)) +
  geom_point() +
    labs(title = "Petal Length vs Petal Width by Species",
       x = "Petal Length",
       y = "Petal Width") +
  theme_minimal()

p2 <- ggplot(iris.df, aes(x = sepal_length, y = sepal_width, color = species)) +
  geom_point() +
    labs(title = "Sepal Length vs Sepal Width by Species",
       x = "Sepal Length",
       y = "Sepal Width") +
  theme_minimal()   

p1 + p2
```
